issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.title is a String (a Book consists of two Strings: title and author). In the solution implementation, Book.title is declared as an Int (let title: Int). This type mismatch is structural: code that follows the problem (e.g. assembling books with string literals for titles) will not compile against the solution's Book definition and students will be confused whether title should be a String or Int.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the type of Book.title in the solution to String (let title: String) so it matches the problem specification. Ensure any code that constructs Book instances uses String titles (as shown in the example assembleBookstore implementation).
